layers.name: Root / The Machine
layers.role: Routing, cross-register memory, and the current map of local authorities.
layers.residual: World or branch history may invalidate the current route without erasing the route that produced it.
layers.reopening: handoff / merge memory -> revised Now Map

layers.name: Arcane Magics
layers.role: Religion, inhabited symbolic memory, ritual, astrology, comparison, and reader release.
layers.residual: Synchronicity, astrology, and symbolic efficacy may remain meaningful while statistical anomaly, predictive accuracy, or acausal mechanism stays separately unearned.
layers.reopening: hostile reading / source removal / independent return / reader release

layers.name: Eclipsis
layers.role: Math & logics, local views, structural relations, and explicitly OPEN carrier bridges.
layers.residual: Consciousness, quantum-gravity, and cosmological mappings remain OPEN where an explicit carrier, observable, or discriminator is still missing.
layers.reopening: carrier map / comparator / discriminator / failure consequence

layers.name: Minerva
layers.role: Developmental engineering, custody, evaluation, enactment, and corrigible self-reconstruction.
layers.residual: The self-model relation must be re-derived under fresh consequence; bounded engineering success does not establish AGI or open-ended RSI.
layers.reopening: sealed or independent return / rollback / successor reconstruction

layers.name: Venus
layers.role: Self & World boundary, self-provenance, open bridges, and provenance-sensitive return.
layers.residual: Self-provenance and prediction can never by themselves exhaust or mint the independent source of correction.

layers.name: OFE
layers.role: Scientific future: future-relative operational discrimination and lawful quotient refinement.
layers.boundary: current future family F != all possible future tests
layers.residual: A richer future family F' may separate states that the current quotient treats as equivalent.
layers.reopening: new admissible future test / separating witness / quotient refinement

virtual.name: World / Other
virtual.role: independently returned consequence not exhausted by current carrier, map, or model

network.name: NETWORK / WWW
network.role: carrier / relational medium; not World / Other and not a global subject
